static_traits.name: Liu Yushan
static_traits.family_status: Husband working in a government department, one son
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological history; no prior psychotherapy history; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, able to clearly describe own distress; the rest Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I have been experiencing inferiority and a sense of failure related to my baking skill, especially after the most recent cake failed to meet Anticipation. These feelings began two years ago when I opened my shop and have intensified in recent months due to a series of baking mistakes. I think the cause of these feelings is my excessively high Demands on myself and fear of disappointing customers. The problem gradually developed to the point where I feel unable to do baking well; whenever there is a baking order I feel pressure and Anxiety, and thoughts of giving up the bakery arise. I have tried improving my technique, Learning new recipes, but Self-doubt persists.
basic_info.core_demands: I am seeking counseling because the sense of failure and Self-doubt are affecting my passion for baking and the bakery's business performance.
growth_experiences: Two years ago after turning baking from a hobby into running a bakery, external expectations and financial Stress significantly increasing. During this period many mistakes occurred (e.g., cakes not rising, pastries not cooked, receiving customer complaints), triggering strong worry about 'disappointing customers' and Self-doubt; the baking that once brought joy was gradually replaced by the pressure of 'must meet standards/perfect'.

special_situations.event: The cake made for a customer did not rise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any mistake appears in my work, it proves I am not suited for baking/I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles practice and refines techniques, seeks and tries new recipes, striving to make every step perfect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This cake is terrible, I simply cannot bake.

special_situations.event: Receiving customer complaints about dissatisfaction with the finished product
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If customers are not satisfied, it means I disappointed everyone, indicating I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-blame and raising self-Demands, Reduced socializing expression, trying to avoid any further small mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I disappointed everyone; it is all my fault.

special_situations.event: Whenever receiving a new baking order
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If expectations cannot be perfectly met, I should not take orders / it shows I am not suited to run a shop
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overchecking and repeatedly confirming every detail, Anxiously rehearsing the worst outcome
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time I may mess up again; the customer will surely be disappointed.

special_situations.event: Some pastries made appearing undercooked and other small mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Either perfect or failure; making a mistake means I am terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pressuring constantly with a 'zero mistakes' goal, driving improvement through Self-denial
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a terrible Baker.

core_conflict.wish: Longing for works to be recognized, gaining affirmation from customers and important others, not disappointing others
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being negated, fearing disappointing others and therefore being judged/Being rejected, further questioning self-worth and career prospects
defense_goal: Preventing failure and criticism by setting extremely high standards and self-harshness
Focuses energy on detail control and technical improvement to gain a sense of safety and controllability

object_relations.self_representation: One who easily disappoints others and needs to constantly prove oneself as not good enough
object_relations.object_representation: Critical judges/others not easily satisfied (e.g., customers)
A partner who is supportive but finds it hard to truly understand one's situation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about customer complaints, product errors, or being asked to review failure situations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating others' dissatisfaction with negation of overall self-worth, worrying relationships and career will suffer
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In counseling dialogue use self-blaming statements (e.g., 'It is all my fault'), Repressed tone, lowering self-worth, avoiding outward expression of dissatisfaction and needs.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to deeply experience feelings during heightened emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning emotions into objects needing control and analysis, to avoid being swallowed up by emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Shifts to discussing recipes, techniques, and process checklists in detail, with a rational tone and clear organization, reducing emotional vocabulary and subjective feeling descriptions.

manifestations: Even with husband's support, still feeling 'no one truly understands my shortcomings and pressure'
From loving baking to being swept along by external expectations, a gap appears between subjective experience and others' expectations
outcomes: Anxiety intensified, Sleep affected and eating disorders
Partner Relationship tension, declining sense of agency and connection

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial ('I am not good enough''I should be perfect')
Over-Reflection and doubt during order-taking and production, being cautious, fearing disappointing others

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes customer expectations and the 'must be perfect' rule as self-evaluation standards
Treats a single mistake as an overall failure, strictly measuring self-worth by external satisfaction

positive_force: Has long-term passion and commitment to baking; willing to try improving techniques and new recipes
Willing to seek professional help and accept behavioral experiments to test beliefs
negative_force: Perfectionism and excessively high self-standards, strongly binding self-worth to others' satisfaction
Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, all-or-nothing, overgeneralization, and personalization appear frequently
Intense Fear of disappointing customers leading to Anxiety, insomnia and irregular eating
Persistent Self-denial and negative self-talk harming Work performance and intimate relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety upon receiving baking orders with overchecking of details, accompanied by Persistent self-doubt
antecedent: Recalling past baking mistakes (cakes not rising, pastries undercooked)
Receiving or worrying about receiving customer complaints
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing disappointing customers and being negated, equating a single mistake with total failure, and evaluating self-capability with a 'must be perfect' standard.
target_behavior.function: Reducing uncertainty through over-control and repeated checking, avoiding potential failure and criticism (short-term Anxiety relief).
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep and diet affected; declining Work quality, declining customer satisfaction; Relationship tension with husband; thoughts of giving up the shop arising.
